name: day_pho_vung_tau
sources: One side of a street of Vũng Tàu from rules (plan 0016): 5 houses wall to wall on a road of 13.0 m, the seed 2. It is no real street. The plan of the street makes the choices that neighbors share; each house is then made from its own request (World.Town.House).

The shares of the types and of the widths of the lots are from adverts of houses in Vũng Tàu and from photos of its streets; no count of a real street is public. The sidewalk of 3 m and its tiles of 0.4 m are from photos; the height of the curb and the pole are a guess.
